Thanks for opening this, and for building with Plyr.

Plyr is deprecated and receives security updates only, so we're closing issues that aren't security reports.

The folks behind Plyr, Vidstack and Media Chrome now work on [Video.js 10](https://videojs.org?utm_source=plyr). The migration guide maps Plyr onto it: [HTML](https://videojs.org/docs/framework/html/guides/migrate-from-plyr?utm_source=plyr) · [React](https://videojs.org/docs/framework/react/guides/migrate-from-plyr?utm_source=plyr).

**Migrating with a coding agent?** Paste the prompt from the guide's AI Quickstart section into your agent: [HTML](https://videojs.org/docs/framework/html/guides/migrate-from-plyr?utm_source=plyr#ai-quickstart) · [React](https://videojs.org/docs/framework/react/guides/migrate-from-plyr?utm_source=plyr#ai-quickstart).

If this still matters to you in Video.js 10, open an issue or discussion in [videojs/video.js](https://github.com/videojs/video.js) and link back here so we keep the context.

If this is a security vulnerability, don't add details here. Report it privately as described in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/sampotts/plyr/blob/master/SECURITY.md).
